interface.shortDescription: Daily Radar, Demand Report, specs and engineering analytics from your team's tools
interface.longDescription:
Devplan is the product intelligence layer for software teams. This plugin brings it into Codex.

Free: a Daily Radar of what shipped, what's moving and what's stuck; a Demand Report of recurring customer needs, adoption blockers and demand nobody is building; grounded specs with a short discovery conversation, technical plan and estimate; and engineering analytics on cycle time, reviews, throughput and flow. Everything is built from the tools you already use: GitHub, Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Zendesk, Gong and more. Your tool data stays in your tools.

Sign in free to save your company context (what you do, who you serve, your goals and your product) so every answer starts out knowing your company.

Connect Devplan for $100 in free credits to run everything on its knowledge graph and unlock Suggested Projects, Customer Release Briefs, Stale Commitments and Changelogs.
